question: Chikungunya fever is an acute disease transmitted by mosquito bites. It is endemic in certain areas of Africa and Asia. In recent years, cases have been recognized in Europe and America. In relation to it, answer the CORRECT answer:

options.opa: The characteristic clinical symptom, apart from fever, is debilitating polyarthralgia.
options.opb: The probable geographical origin of the disease is in South Asia.
options.opc: The diagnosis is usually made during the viremic phase by PCR.
options.opd: Mortality is higher in adolescents and young people.
